caseName: Mason v. Midwestern Gas Transmission Co.
caseNameFull: MASON et ux. v. MIDWESTERN GAS TRANSMISSION CO.
attorneys: Stanley B. Balbach for appellants., Charles A. Bane, Justin A. Stanley and James E. Knox, Jr., for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
